mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spell Shield</titleLeft><mainText>The next enemy ability used on this champion will have no effect.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir gains a short burst of Movement Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>When Sivir hits an enemy champion with her basic attacks or abilities, she gains <speed>50 Movement Speed</speed> for 2 seconds.</mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Combat Momentum</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased Movement Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>On The Hunt</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Movement and Attack Speeds are increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Spell Shield</titleLeft><mainText>The next enemy ability used on this champion will have no effect.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir creates a magical barrier on herself that blocks a single enemy ability. She regains Mana if an ability is successfully blocked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir creates a spell shield for @Duration@ seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy ability. If an ability is blocked by the shield, Sivir regains <scaleMana>@ManaReturn@ Mana</scaleMana>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, which deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first unit and @FallOffRatio*100@% reduced damage to each subsequent target down to a minimum of @FallOffMinimum*100@%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>On The Hunt</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Movement and Attack Speeds are increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir leads her allies into battle granting them increased Movement and Attack Speeds for a period of time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir's battle prowess emanates for @UltDuration@ seconds, increasing her <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @HuntAttackSpeed*100@%</attackSpeed> and <speed>Movement Speed by @MS*100@%</speed>. Nearby allies gain @AlliedEffectiveness*100@% of Sivir's benefits for the duration.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ricochet</titleLeft><mainText>Sivir's attacks will bounce, dealing reduced damage with each additional hit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir's next basic attack will bounce between targets, dealing reduced damage with each successive hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir's basic attack will bounce to <attention>@MaxBounces@</attention> additional targets, dealing @FallOffRatio*100@% less damage with each bounce.
